decisions.reason: The same-message INTRODUCE already records both images and internal links as publication prerequisites, so no additional or corrected Event is needed.
The same-message MODIFY already records that internal links are required before publication.
The publication prerequisite does not change the required article type, trial inclusion, or article count.
The image and internal-link publication condition does not alter topic-selection requirements.
The source decision imposes publication prerequisites but does not change blog keyword selection.
The keyword research report and its search-volume and replacement-keyword requirements remain unchanged.
The article publication condition does not modify the scope or contents of the SEO plan deliverable.
